Fullness grows per active component tick using the species interval in native days.
Hunger changes the accumulation speed rather than directly reducing the eventual batch amount.
Fullness is capped at one cycle; missed gathering does not bank unlimited cycles.
Fed growth multiplier is one.
Hungry growth multiplier is one half.
Urgently hungry growth multiplier is one quarter.
Starving stops new wool accumulation.
Ordinary scanning searches spawned pawns of the worker faction.

rules.interpretation: Assignment needs casual-interaction eligibility and an ordinary reservation.
Work progress is saved on the driver, separately from animal fullness.
The job reserves its target to prevent simultaneous handlers.
Target disappearance or forbidden status interrupts the driver.
Target downing interrupts work.
The driver also rejects loss of casual interruptibility.
Wooling requires reaching contact with the animal.
Starting work asks the animal to wait and preserves posture.
Actual gathering intervals grant Animals experience before reading speed.
Progress scales with AnimalGatherSpeed and elapsed simulation ticks.
The normal driver invokes Gathered only after work reaches its total.
Finish action releases the animal only when it is still in the imposed maintain-posture wait.
Contact loss interrupts the work toil.
The work toil rechecks active full resource during work, including after load.
Yield stat is a single all-or-nothing success roll, not an amount multiplier.
Failed gathering produces a wasted-product feedback branch without spawning wool.
On success, output amount is stochastically rounded species amount times actual fullness.
Successful output is split into real stacks bounded by the resource stack limit.
Each output stack is placed near the worker, not remotely credited to colony stock; the return value is ignored here.
Fullness resets after success, product waste or placement failure.
Wool fullness is saved on the animal, separately from driver progress.
The current life stage must permit shearing.
Anomaly shambler animals cannot grow wool.
The life-stage flag defaults false.
The worker requires the species shearable component.
Shearing requires 1700 work, not fixed ticks.
Hunger affects accumulation speed.
XML hunger base is converted to per-tick nutrition before additional modifiers.
Material compatibility requires overlapping stuff categories.
Generated apparel recipes retain actual material identity.
Material filters follow the target item stuff compatibility.
Ingredient mixing defaults false.
No-mix bill selection combines only stacks of the same resource for one requirement.
Unfinished clothing retains its chosen material.
Resumption uses the unfinished item existing stuff.
The finished product receives actual stuff identity.
The material identity is persisted.
Item stats use stuff factors, not the resource own stat bases.
Missing stuff factors default one.
Material power contributes garment multiplier times material power.
Higher-priority material parts run before default-priority quality parts.
Part priority defaults zero.
Quality multiplies accumulated material-aware value, subject to configured gain caps.
Computed item base value includes its actual material value.
Computed base value adds work times 0.0036 when work exceeds two.
The HP market-value curve respects the item definition healthAffectsPrice flag.

Native gathering has no checked placement retry owner.
Generated clothing recipes do not enable mixed material requirements.
